name: mention

frames.best_why: Frame 5 shows the typed @is trigger with the filtered teammate list fully open.

tagline: Type @ in a comment box to pick a teammate from a filtered list.
summary: A comment textarea that watches for the @ symbol and opens a small list of teammates, narrowing as you keep typing. Picking a row drops that person's name into the sentence as a highlighted mention.
appearance: A bordered dark textarea with a small Leave a comment label above and dim placeholder text inside, set on black. Typing @ brings a small rounded popover of rows, each a white name with a grey email beside it; the inserted name in the text is a blue pill.
behaviour: Typing @ opens the list near the field, and each further letter filters the rows to matching names. Choosing a row inserts that name into the sentence as a blue highlighted mention and closes the list.
demo_content: Northwind teammates Olivia Martin, Isabella Nguyen, Emma Wilson, Jackson Lee and William Kim with .dev emails.
search_phrases: tag a teammate in a comment
type at to pick a person
filterable list of people while typing
insert a user name into text
use_when: People write comments or messages where others must be addressed directly from a known team list.
avoid_when: It needs a fixed list of people and a textarea; for a plain free-form note a normal textarea is simpler.
customise: Compose a label, an input and a content list of items as children; style the mention tag through classes on the root, and swap the textarea through asChild.
weight_why: A textarea plus a small popover that only mounts while an @ token is active.

a11y.note: No reduced-motion handling: the popover still fades and zooms in for users who ask for less motion.

issues: The suggestion popover opens far from the text field, near the bottom-right of the stage.
In frame 3 the third suggestion row is cut off at the panel edge.
polish_why: Clean field and list styling, but the popover placement and a clipped row weaken the demo.
